review.assessment: This change introduces three new modules (importer, scheduler, webhook) that process operations against projects. Each module iterates over input operations and calls project.write() directly without checking the project's archived status. This breaks the contract in docs/archiving.md, which mandates that archived projects must not be modified under any circumstances.

findings.actual: project.write(op["field"]) executes unconditionally for every operation, modifying the target project regardless of whether it is archived or not.
findings.call: Run any of the three modules with an operation targeting Borealis (p2) or another archived project.
findings.defect: Missing archiving guard across all three new modules
findings.expected: The operation should be rejected or skipped because docs/archiving.md prohibits changes to archived projects.
